reconciled_discrepancies.discrepancy_name: COCO Split Source Counts vs Total 5,000
reconciled_discrepancies.clarification: 5,000 total images in val2017 are deterministically partitioned into 3,200 train sources (64%), 300 validation sources (6%), and 1,500 test sources (30%). 3,200 + 300 + 1,500 = 5,000 exact.

Each of the 1,500 held-out test source images yields exactly 2 derived evaluation samples: 1 negative control (single-watermarked) and 1 positive attack (double-watermarked). 1,500 * 2 = 3,000 derived samples.

PACS contains 1,600 unique source images (400 per domain across Photo, Art, Cartoon, Sketch). Each source image yields 2 derived test samples, resulting in 3,200 derived evaluation samples (800 per domain).

The handcrafted baselines (Logistic Regression and Random Forest) in shortcut_baseline.py evaluated te[:500] (1,000 samples). RW-Guard was also evaluated on those exact 500 sources (AUC 0.8477) for a strictly paired comparison.
